newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pirelli wins A$10 mln cable contract.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli wins A$10 mln cable contract.

text.p: Pirelli Cables Australia Ltd said on Friday it has won an A$10 million contract with ACTEW (ACT Electricity and Water) as sole power cable supplier for the next five years.
Pirelli said the agreement was expected to develop into a long-term relationship through greater co-operation between the energy corporation and the cable manufacturer.
The contract follows Pirelli's A$50 million cut-to-length cable contract with Western Power.

ACTEW manager supply services, Dennis Collins, said in a statement the corporation was embarking on a programme of rationalising its power cable products and would be working closely with Pirelli on the updating of old cable designs and the establishment of new information systems.
Under the agreement, Pirelli also takes responsibility for logistical management of cable drums and scap.
